summary: Full test of the Aug-2026 Stock architecture refactor (stock_items collection + Transfer-to-Stock flow replacing the old Deal Tracking card). Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_stock_module_v2.py with 25 pytest cases covering (a) 401 on every endpoint, (b) POST /api/submissions/{sid}/transfer-to-stock — success + already-transferred 400 + duplicate stock_number 409 + subject-to-view 400 + non-managerial 403, (c) POST /api/submissions/{sid}/untransfer-from-stock — happy path + not-transferred 400 + sold-item 400, (d) GET /api/stock — new shape, no legacy reference/purchase_price_zar/front_photo, (e) PATCH /api/stock/{id} — target-price only, multi-field (mileage/colour/condition_score), duplicate 409, blank 400, sold 400, non-managerial 403, (f) POST /api/stock/{id}/mark-sold — success + item disappears from list, (g) GET /api/stock/export.csv — exact-string header match for dealer AND admin (extra Dealership column), (h) legacy PATCH /api/stock/{id}/target-price returns 404 (route removed). All 25 tests PASS after two selector fixes to handle the /api/admin/submissions response envelope `{submissions:[...]}`. Frontend smoke test @ 390x844 as minitest@example.com: 'Deal Tracking' text is gone from vehicle detail (count=0); new transfer-to-stock-card is present with correct icon+title 'Stock', the 'Transfer to Stock' button renders disabled (computed opacity 0.4) with helper text 'Only managerial users on this dealership can transfer vehicles into stock.'; no 'Subject-to-view' notice on the priced sub; Reconditioning/Assign Suppliers actions correctly hidden pre-transfer. Stock screen loads with new empty state (no rows in preview DB after purge). No react_native issues detected in the touched files. Two MINOR stale-copy issues flagged for main agent (empty-state on /stock still references the old deal-done language). DB cleanup script committed at /app/scripts/cleanup_test_stock.py for future iterations.

issues: Header sub-label still reads 'Your dealership · deal done, not yet sold' — this is legacy wording from the derived-view era; should be updated to reference the transfer flow (e.g. 'Your dealership · transferred, not yet sold').
Empty state copy still reads 'Mark a deal as done on a submission to add it here.' — should be updated to 'Transfer a submission to stock to add it here.' since Deal Tracking is gone.

action_items: Update /app/frontend/app/(app)/stock.tsx header sub-label from 'deal done, not yet sold' to something like 'transferred to stock, not yet sold'.
Update the /stock empty-state message to instruct users to Transfer a submission (not Mark a deal as done).

The legacy test_stock_module.py (iteration_54) is now stale — it still asserts against the old shape (reference/purchase_price_zar/front_photo columns + PATCH /target-price endpoint). Consider deleting it so it doesn't confuse regression runs.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/stock.py is clean and self-contained. Uniqueness check is case-insensitive via _norm_stock_number → verified via manual seed test that a fake stock_item with STK-TEST-DUP-SEED-1 in one dealership blocks both a new transfer AND a PATCH-rename with the same number, returning 409 with clear message.
PATCH endpoint correctly denormalises stock_number back to the parent submission when it's renamed (line 513-518) — good for keeping the vehicle-detail badge accurate.

Un-transfer clears exactly the 4 fields it stamped (stock_item_id, stock_number, transferred_to_stock_at, transferred_to_stock_by) — verified via direct MongoDB inspection showing {} after untransfer.
The `_can_write_stock` helper cleanly gates PATCH + mark-sold + un-transfer to managerial-only, matching TransferToStockCard's `canTransfer` prop semantics.

One micro-inefficiency (non-blocking): _row_for_api is called both in the GET /stock loop AND again on PATCH; totally fine at MVP scale but could be inlined if this endpoint ever becomes hot. Not an issue to fix now.

TransferToStockCard.tsx correctly disables the button when EITHER !canTransfer OR !isFullyValued and shows the appropriate mutually-exclusive messaging (guard notice for subject-to-view, helper text for non-managerial). Good UX separation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all mobile smoke checks pass, two copy-only design issues flagged)

seed_data_creation: During tests: transient stock_items created via the transfer endpoint (all prefixed STK-TEST-* and STK-TEST-DUP-*) plus one seeded fake stock_item to force the duplicate-stock-number branch. All test data purged via /app/scripts/cleanup_test_stock.py before and after runs (final state: 0 stock_items in DB). No dealer-account seeding required — admin@fourbuy.co.za was sufficient for the managerial path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) The stock_items collection is the new source of truth — always run `python /app/scripts/cleanup_test_stock.py` before/after your suite to keep uniqueness checks deterministic. 2) The /api/admin/submissions endpoint returns `{submissions:[...], counts:{...}, archive_after_days:N}` — use `body.get('items') or body.get('submissions') or []` to be robust. 3) In the preview DB, most dealerships have only ONE priced+un-transferred submission, so tests that need TWO subs in the SAME dealership (dup stock_number branch) rely on inserting a fake seed stock_item directly via motor — see test_transfer_rejects_duplicate_stock_number and test_patch_duplicate_stock_number_409. 4) After a mark-sold run, the sold stock_item stays in the collection (with sold=true) — the cleanup script also purges those. 5) Old test_stock_module.py (iteration_54) is stale and can be removed.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Everything requested was verified functional. Design copy issues on /stock are cosmetic-only (empty-state wording); logic is 100% correct.
